response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS igm FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID), m AS (SELECT AVG(igm) AS mu FROM j), d AS (SELECT j.ID, j.SEX, j.igm, j.igm - m.mu AS dev FROM j, m), g AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(dev) AS avg_dev FROM d GROUP BY SEX) SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.igm AS `aCL IgM`, d.dev AS deviation, d.dev - g.avg_dev AS excess_over_sex_avg FROM d JOIN g ON d.SEX = g.SEX WHERE d.dev > g.avg_dev ORDER BY excess_over_sex_avg DESC LIMIT 10
